text.tspan: A routine centered on the middle station
Places connected by his routine; this is not a measured map.
His work and his room share a
Bed, fork, bicycle; he sleeps alone on
The cellist's route after the second March
A > B: room above / A > C: working view / A > D: Sunday routine / D > E: Sunday routine / A > F: cellist avoids platform
The text locates the room over the station; it does not put every destination within sight of the cable.
